stories.title: Another No 1 falls as Notre Dame hold off Miami to shake up college football playoff race
summary: Carr throws for 319 yards and three TDs in 31-24 winNo 4 Irish avenge loss that cost them playoff berthMiami comeback falls short after disputed late callCJ Carr threw for 319 yards and three touchdowns as No 4 Notre Dame avenged their most damaging loss of last season, racing to a 21-point lead before holding on to beat top-ranked Miami 31-24 on Saturday night.Micah Gilbert caught two of Carr’s touchdown passes, Jordan Faison had the other and Nolan James Jr added a rushing score for Notre Dame (8-1, No 11 College Football Playoff), who entered the game knowing another defeat to Miami could derail their national championship hopes.

stories.title: Enzo Maresca rues Manchester City’s lack of desire after defeat at Nottingham Forest
summary: ‘You need desire and intensity … we didn’t match them’City have now lost three successive league matchesEnzo Maresca blamed his side’s lack of desire and the way they were outgunned in duels for a third successive Premier League defeat.
In the first half we lost all the duels, all the contacts.
In this kind of game, if you’re not able to win duels and second balls like in the first half, you struggle.
